name: Scary Gorillas 26
summary:
An exhilarating and immersive horror game that puts you in the shoes of a gorilla navigating a terrifying world. With movement mechanics inspired by Gorilla Tag, you can swing your arms and move fluidly as you escape from menacing monsters.
Explore various game modes, including Sandbox and Glass Bridge, where you can team up with friends or challenge yourself against other players. If the horror becomes too intense or you find yourself bored with the game modes, simply grab your SG Tablet to chat with fello
